==Structured data==
All structured data in the Item and Property namespaces is released under the '''Creative Commons CC-0 waiver''', effectively placing it in the public domain. By uploading data to Librarybase you certify you are authorized to release it under this waiver.

==Articles==
By contributing to the article namespace you agree to license your work under '''Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 3.0''' license.

==Files==
While file uploads will be permitted in limited circumstances, the licenses allowed on Librarybase include any license that allows for redistribution by anyone. This includes any of the Creative Commons licenses, NC and ND included. Public domain and CC-0 content are also allowed.

Licenses that permit only Librarybase to redistribute will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

The preferred license is '''Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0'''.
